references.text: Joshua selects thirty thousand men to lie in ambush, which prepares the deployment of the troops mentioned in verse 9.
Confirms the location of the ambush between Bethel and Ai, the same geographical position mentioned in verse 9.
Bethel and Ai are mentioned together geographically, highlighting the strategic importance of the area between these cities.
Bethel and Ai are again mentioned together, showing that the ambush strategy included both cities.
Bethel is mentioned in connection with Abraham, who pitched his tent between Bethel and Ai, the same geographical area.
A similar ambush strategy is used by Israel, where troops lie in hiding and wait for the right moment to attack.
